episode_title: Maverick's Silver Vista Drill Program, Following Up the Holes No One Went Back To

real_qa.q: What are the drill results from Maverick Gold and Silver's Silver Vista program in British Columbia?
real_qa.r: Maverick announced a five-hole, 1,300-meter drill program at Silver Vista property. Previous operators reported intervals including 46 meters averaging 48 grams of silver and 0.62% copper, and 47.8 meters averaging 37 grams of silver per ton and 0.21% copper. The current drill program is designed to follow up on the two best holes that were not previously followed, test the geological theory of a sedimentary-hosted copper-silver deposit, and step out to add tonnage.
real_qa.requete: Silver Vista drill results Maverick Gold

real_qa.q: Why did previous operators abandon Silver Vista's best drill holes without following them up?
real_qa.r: Ian Foreman states that previous drilling campaigns occurred in 1991, 1992, 2018, and 2021, but the company does not know the rationale or mindset behind why the best holes were not followed. He notes that when exploration companies drill holes and do not achieve desired results or when market conditions change, they often leave the property. Maverick inherited this situation and is now determined to follow up on those two best holes that were left unexplored.
real_qa.requete: Silver Vista previous drilling abandoned holes

real_qa.q: What percentage of global copper resources are hosted in sedimentary-hosted copper-silver deposits?
real_qa.r: According to Ian Foreman, 23% of all the copper resources in the world are hosted in sedimentary-hosted copper-silver deposits. These deposit types can be areally quite extensive and have thicknesses capable of adding significant tonnage. Maverick's comparable deposit is what Hecla operates in Montana, which has sizable reserves with grades similar to Maverick's best hole.
real_qa.requete: sedimentary hosted copper silver deposits 23 percent

real_qa.q: How long will Maverick's Silver Vista drill program take and when will assay results be available?
real_qa.r: The drill program will take approximately three to four weeks to complete since all drill holes are relatively close to each other. Assay results are expected within six to eight weeks, though there is a backlog in assay labs due to high exploration activity in British Columbia's Golden Triangle and Porphyry District. Maverick plans to submit each hole to the lab individually as it is completed, logged, and sampled, with results coming back in sequential order.
real_qa.requete: Silver Vista drill program completion assay timeline

real_qa.q: What is Maverick Gold and Silver's drilling sequence for its three projects in the next 12 months?
real_qa.r: Silver Vista in British Columbia is being drilled immediately as the permit and flow-through funding are in place. The next project to be drilled will be Jericho in Nevada after follow-up work and permitting. Gator, also in Nevada, is at higher elevation and receives snow, so field work will occur before the drill program is planned for spring or Q2 2027. Maverick aims to work on properties year-round and to be aggressive in advancing multiple projects to the drill stage.
real_qa.requete: Maverick Gold drilling sequence Jericho Gator Nevada

real_qa.q: How did Maverick Gold expand Silver Vista's property after obtaining its multi-year land use permit?
real_qa.r: After receiving multi-year land use permit approval in approximately six and a half months, Maverick expanded Silver Vista from its core area to 17 claims covering approximately 6,500 hectares. The expanded claims, which were staked in January, cover two historic exploration targets that had received soil sampling anomalies coinciding with similar geology to the main MR target being drilled. This expansion allows Maverick to have multiple targets on the same property and increases the probability of success.
real_qa.requete: Silver Vista property expansion 17 claims hectares permit

guest.bio_context: Ian Foreman is VP of Exploration at Maverick Gold and Silver with a career history in exploration success. He has demonstrated expertise in geological modeling, three-dimensional drill hole analysis, and sedimentary-hosted copper-silver deposit exploration.
